- **What I sent:** a short reply saying it's noted and stays between us. They asked for no action, so I took none.
- **One thing to check:** 7 July is before today's date in the workspace (14 Oct 2026), so they may mean 7 July 2027. They said no action was needed, so I didn't ask. It might be worth confirming the year when the date comes up again.
